evidence.note: Upper cabinet above the refrigerator is closed; the user's hand approaches the right-hand door.
The right-hand upper-cabinet door is visibly swung open.
Both upper-cabinet doors remain open immediately before the closing actions.
The cabinet facade is fully closed and flush again.

events.object_description: Right-hand hinged door of the upper cabinet above the refrigerator

evidence.note: The other upper-cabinet door still appears closed while the right-hand door is already open.
The user grips and swings the second cabinet door outward.
Both upper-cabinet doors are visibly open.
Both doors are still open shortly before the user closes them.
Both doors are closed and flush.

events.object_description: Left-hand hinged door of the upper cabinet above the refrigerator

evidence.note: Wide upper drawer to the left of the stove is closed.
The user pulls the drawer outward, exposing stored food packages.
The drawer is being pushed inward and remains partly open.
The left-side drawer front is flush and closed.

events.object_description: Wide upper storage drawer immediately left of the stove

evidence.note: Wide upper drawer to the right of the stove is closed.
The user pulls the drawer open, revealing cutting boards and kitchen supplies.
The right-side drawer remains open immediately before closure.
The right-side drawer front is flush and closed.

events.object_description: Wide upper storage drawer immediately right of the stove

notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two upper-cabinet doors are counted separately because they are manipulated sequentially; their individual closing order is partially obscured, so their off-frame estimates are close together and less certain.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens both hinged doors of the cabinet above the refrigerator, later opens a wide drawer left of the stove and another wide drawer right of the stove, and finally closes all four movable parts.
